items.name: Default
items.template:
<style>
  #root-inner {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100vh;
  }
</style>
<ui-popover id="type-popover">popover</ui-popover>
<nve-button popovertarget="type-popover">toggle</nve-button>
items.summary: Basic popover toggled by a button using the native popovertarget API.
